content: Obramat ES shows both 'IVA' and 'sin IVA' unit prices and 'Mejor precio por cantidad' (buy by unit vs by pack/box/coil/pallet; e.g. brick 0.40/unit vs pallet of 480 = 0.38/unit). obramat.pt/obramat.es return 403 to plain fetch (anti-bot). Leroy Merlin PT shows price per m2 and per box for flooring; box must be bought whole. PT law (DL 138/90 as amended by DL 162/99) requires consumer prices with all taxes and unit-of-measure price.
